metadata.description: Plugins maintained alongside the systemd source tree. systemd-migration moves container orchestration onto systemd-native primitives: adapters discover an estate (Docker Swarm first, Podman next), a planner writes a plan for review, and one skill per systemd component renders its part of the result.

plugins.name: systemd-migration
plugins.description: Discover a container estate, plan its move onto systemd, and render every systemd component the plan selects: services with RootMStack=, machines, networkd, resolved, resource control, credentials, journald, storage, extensions, portable services, and Podman Quadlet as an adapter target. Includes the verifier and a Managed Agents harness.
